rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: In accordance with Article 82 of the Constitution, in the presence of members of the Federation Council, State Duma deputies and Constitutional Court judges, Vladimir Putin took the oath to the people of Russia in the Grand Kremlin Palace.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Headed "Vladimir Putin took office as President of Russia", the item states that Constitutional Court Chairman Valery Zorkin announced Putin's assumption of office as President of the Russian Federation, after which the Presidential Regiment was presented to the President and Supreme Commander-in-Chief "on the occasion of his taking office"; Putin speaks "taking office as President of Russia".
rows.locator: Heading; lead paragraphs 3-4; Putin's address, paragraph 3
